one_line: Hoysala king of Karnataka who defeated the Cholas at Talakadu and raised the Chennakesava temple at Belur.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, athletic yet regal build, warrior-king physique.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium-brown Kannada complexion, straight nose, sharp jawline, neatly trimmed moustache with short beard along the jaw, calm focused eyes with a determined gaze, default expression a composed, confident half-smile showing poised authority.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair drawn back into a mid-length knot at the back of the head, front hair smoothed with a slight wave, adorned with a simple gold Hoysala-style cylindrical crown-band circling the head with a small central leaf-shaped ornament on the forehead.
appearance.costume: Sleeveless but fully covered upper body with a fitted pale cream cotton angarakha-style tunic extending to mid-thigh, over which he wears a rich dark green silk uttariya drape coming over the left shoulder and across the chest, wrapped securely and falling behind; lower body in a tightly wrapped deep maroon cotton dhoti with fine golden border pleated in front and reaching the ankles; feet in brown leather strapped sandals; arms adorned with plain gold armlets on both biceps and layered gold bangles on wrists; a broad gold necklace with small pendant, and a waist-belt of gold plaques securing the dhoti and symbolizing royalty; subtle woven geometric patterns on the dhoti border and uttariya edge echo Hoysala stone motifs.
appearance.signature: A long Hoysala-style sword with a gently curved single-edged steel blade, plain iron crossguard, and a dark wooden hilt wrapped in deep red cloth, the scabbard hanging from his gold-plaque waist belt at his left hip.

ref_desc: Vishnuvardhana is a medium-brown, oval-faced Hoysala king with a gold band-crown, black hair knot, cream tunic, dark green silk shoulder drape, deep maroon bordered dhoti, gold jewellery, brown sandals, and a curved sword with red-wrapped wooden hilt at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Hoysala king Vishnuvardhana: an early-30s, athletic, medium-brown Karnataka monarch with an oval face, straight nose, sharp jaw, trimmed moustache and short beard, and calm determined eyes. His thick black hair is pulled into a mid-length knot at the back, front hair smoothed with a slight wave, topped by a simple gold cylindrical crown-band with a small leaf-shaped ornament centered on his forehead. He wears a fitted pale cream cotton angarakha-style tunic extending to mid-thigh, fully covering his torso, with a rich dark green silk uttariya draped over his left shoulder, crossing the chest and flowing behind him. His lower body is wrapped in a tightly pleated deep maroon cotton dhoti with a fine golden border, reaching the ankles, and he has brown leather strapped sandals on his feet. Gold armlets circle both biceps, layered gold bangles ring his wrists, a broad gold necklace with a small central pendant rests at his collarbones, and a waist-belt of gold plaques secures the dhoti and marks his royal status, with subtle geometric patterns on the dhoti border and uttariya edges inspired by Hoysala temple carvings. At his left hip hangs his signature Hoysala sword: a long, gently curved single-edged steel blade with a plain iron crossguard, dark wooden hilt wrapped in deep red cloth, and a simple scabbard attached to the gold-plaque belt. Show him from multiple angles in this one image, keeping the dark green, deep maroon, gold, cream, and brown palette consistent.
